name: linocut
title: Linocut
description: A printmaker’s portfolio laid out like proofs on the bench: on a lino-brown ground every project is a white sheet with one burnt-umber block, the title cut out of it in heavy capitals, and a pencil line beneath with the year, the client and the artist’s signature.

tokens.--color-bg: the lino ground behind everything — the bench the proofs lie on
tokens.--color-text: text and headings, on the lino and on the paper sheets; the focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text on the lino: the footer, the year in the list of more work, empty-list notes
tokens.--color-accent: the one ink: every printed block, the inked current menu entry, link underlines, quotation bars and the short rule
tokens.--color-sheet: the proofing paper of every sheet — and the colour of the letters cut out of a block
tokens.--color-pencil: pencil writing on a sheet: year, client and signature under a print, dates, the label over the work done
tokens.--color-rule: faint pencil rules on a sheet — table lines, entry dividers, the box around code, the mat behind a cover picture
tokens.--color-shadow: the shadow a sheet casts on the lino
tokens.--font-block: heavy grotesque for the cut capitals: blocks, the name, page titles, menu, section headings
tokens.--font-text: old-style serif for everything read at length
tokens.--font-pencil: old-style serif, set in italic, for the pencil line under a print
tokens.--text-s: size of the pencil line, project notes on the sheets, tables and the footer
tokens.--text-l: size of the opening sentence on a project page and post titles in a list
tokens.--text-block: size of the cut title on a proof in the work list
tokens.--text-block-l: size of the cut title on a project page
tokens.--text-xl: size of page titles and the home page statement
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of cut titles and page titles
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--block-width: the fixed width of every block in the work list — a longer title makes a taller block, never a wider one
tokens.--block-width-l: the width of the block on a project page
tokens.--sheet-min: narrowest a sheet in the work list may be — smaller means more sheets across
tokens.--sheet-pad: the paper margin around a print in the work list (the bottom margin is half as deep again)
tokens.--grid-gap: space between sheets on the bench
tokens.--block-edge: corner rounding of a block — slightly uneven, as a hand-cut edge is
tokens.--underline: thickness of the umber underline under links
tokens.--space-1: spacing scale — tight: inside the menu and lists
tokens.--space-2: spacing scale — small: the header and under labels
tokens.--space-3: spacing scale — base: the page gutter on phones and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: spacing scale — roomy: above and below page titles, the gutter on wider screens
tokens.--space-5: spacing scale — section: above the notes of a project and the list of more work
